name: meshweaver-mobile
description: MeshWeaver on React Native / Expo — the native leaf pack over @meshweaver/react/core. The MAUI peer.

scripts.web:export: expo export --platform web && node scripts/pwa-inject.mjs dist/index.html

_expo_sdk57_note: Expo SDK 57 + react-native 0.86.2 + react 19.2.8 — the combination `expo@57`'s own
bundledNativeModules.json names, so every version here is upstream's pairing rather than a
guess. This finishes the migration issue #1584 opened: the npm-major sweep (688ce589b) had
moved expo 52->57 and react 18->19 while PINNING react-native at 0.76.5, which cannot resolve
(RN 0.76 hard-peers react ^18.2.0), and a1ed1eb34 held the whole package back at SDK 52 until
the port could be done deliberately.
expo-av is GONE from SDK 57 (it is not in bundledNativeModules.json at all) and is replaced by
TWO packages with different APIs — expo-audio for capture (src/speech/expoRecorder.ts) and
expo-video for the Video leaf (src/rnContainers.tsx). See those files for the per-call-site
notes; the wire format the speech pipeline depends on (16 kHz mono, WAV on iOS / AAC .m4a on
Android) is preserved exactly, because /api/speech/transcribe and the Whisper container are
typescript stays 5.x here, unlike the other clients (which are on 7 after #1583). @expo/cli
reads tsconfig through the CLASSIC TypeScript compiler API that TS 7 deleted, so `expo export`
— the RN web Playwright job — dies with
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getCurrentDirectory')
This is unchanged by the SDK upgrade: SDK 57's @expo/cli still calls ts.parseJsonConfigFileContent.
The tsconfig `paths` React dedupe is likewise still required — it is a property of sharing
source across two packages with their own node_modules, not of any version skew.
_overrides_note: postcss: @expo/metro-config pins a version below the 8.5.x patch line. Same major, no API
change, and reachable from what we build (the web export bundles CSS through metro-config).
